description: Test file for Windows filesystem utilities in Kubernetes, including disk usage and filesystem info tests.

methods.name: TestDiskUsage
methods.description: Tests the DiskUsage function for correctness by comparing calculated usage with actual file sizes.

methods.name: TestInfo
methods.description: Tests the Info function for filesystem and inode information on directories and files.

methods.name: validateInfo
methods.description: Validates that filesystem info metrics are greater than zero and inodes are zero on Windows.
